newsitem.title: JAPAN: Monetary policy aimed at ensuring recovery -- BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Monetary policy aimed at ensuring recovery -- BOJ.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will continue to conduct monetary policy with an emphasis on ensuring a secure base for economic recovery, BOJ governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Thursday.

Asked whether it was time to tighten credit to avoid the demerits of present record-low interest rates, Matsushita said: "For the time being, we will carry out monetary policy with an emphasis on ensuring a secure base for the economic recovery."
He reiterated the central bank's view that the economy was gradually recovering and gathering strength.
But he added that for the recovery to become sustainable, private demand needed to grow stronger.
Matsushita also said that recent weakness in Japanse stock prices reflected the cautious economic outlook held by businesses.
